newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 17.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Commentary says financial markets face double task of risk control and expansion in 1997.
- The Bank of China sets up its first international holdings company based in London.
- Commentary says restructuring of listed firms helps improve quality of their assets.
- BUSINESS NEWS - The central government removes right of local authorities to charge 23 administrative fees including fees for foreigner visas.
- Half the residents in Pudong are now reluctant to move to the west part of Shanghai due to the development of the new area.
